item.title: “She is not to be trusted”: Right-wing media turn on Pam Bondi as Trump’s Epstein scandal grows
item.description: As fallout from the Trump administration’s handling of the Jeffrey Epstein case continues to grow, right-wing media have set the sights of their blame on Attorney General Pam Bondi. Bondi’s testimony before Congress’ House Judiciary Committee on February 11 — which one conservative host called a “complete disaster” — follows months of right-wing media accusations that she has “lied to us” or is involved in a “cover-up” of the Epstein scandal. item.title: Right-wing media’s claims that ICE agents need to be masked for safety fall apart
item.description: Right-wing media have claimed Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection agents are in danger of being “doxed” and even murdered if they are unable to conceal their identity. New reporting shows that working in immigration enforcement is actually safer than being a civilian, and there are no recorded incidents of agents being doxed.
